The full 5-seed × 50-epoch × {se3sb, tmqm} dual-init spec requires ~12-24 hours GPU wall-time per init on RTX 5090 — deferred to R20 P2 (TODO-82 G2 + R20·P2 already exists from TODO-82e final close-out). Path forward: R20·P2 (full 5-seed × 50-epoch × {se3sb, tmqm} dual-init on RTX 5090 after tmQM arch mismatch fix).
